name: Estonia
convention: Statutory public holidays per the Pühade ja tähtpäevade seadus (banks closed on statutory holidays). Unlike the Nordic fixtures this lists the full statutory set, including the always-Sunday holidays the statute names (Easter Sunday, Pentecost) — flagged in notes. KEY DIFFERENCE from LV/LT: Easter Monday is NOT an Estonian public holiday. No substitute-day shifting.
sources: https://www.riigiteataja.ee/en/eli/ee/527122022003/consolide/current (Public Holidays and Days of National Importance Act — via search-tool snippet of the statute text; the portal is JS-rendered and resisted direct fetch)

confidence.2025: MEDIUM — statute list via snippet, dates cross-checked against aggregators; one aggregator's wrong weekday claim for 2025-05-01 was rejected by arithmetic (2025-05-01 is a Thursday)
confidence.2027: MEDIUM — dates derived from the (undisputed) rules; no per-date aggregator cross-check was run. Re-verify the statute directly before encoding the data file.

notes: Always-Sunday entries (statutory but never affecting working-day math under weekend [0,6]): Easter Sunday (04-20/04-05/03-28) and Pentecost (06-08/05-24/05-16, easterOffset +49).
Fixed dates: Feb 24 (Independence Day), Jun 23 (Victory Day), Jun 24 (Midsummer), Aug 20 (Restoration of Independence), Dec 24 (statutory in Estonia, unlike most of Europe).
